tables.text_helper: Table 87, "TIM2/TIM3 register map and reset values", in section 18.4.26 (TIMx register map) on page 515. Register map: offsets, 32-bit field layout and reset values for 25 registers: TIMx_CR1, TIMx_CR2, TIMx_SMCR, TIMx_DIER, TIMx_SR, TIMx_EGR, TIMx_CCMR1 Output  Compare mode, TIMx_CCMR1 Input Capture  mode, TIMx_CCMR2 Output  Compare mode, TIMx_CCMR2 Input Capture  mode, TIMx_CCER, TIMx_CNT and 13 more.
